summary: Completed full M9 milestone documentation audit across all five manifest documents.

file-tree.md: Added missing ThumbnailGeneratorViewModel.cs (WP-017) entry to ViewModels section; added missing FfmpegThumbnailGeneratorService.cs (WP-020) entry to Infrastructure/Library section; updated MoviePropertiesViewModel.cs annotation to reflect WP-032 LoadMediaInfoAsync implementation (removed 'stored; not yet used' text, documented [ObservableProperty] FileType/Resolution/Duration/Bitrate and LoadMediaInfoAsync).

constraints.md: Added two new M9 UI/MVVM rules — (1) ThumbnailsView bidirectional selection sync _isSyncingSelection guard pattern; (2) MovieEditorView image tab sub-VMs require all five M9 services full-or-nothing. Added two new M9 Open Items — (1) IDisposable gap in MovieEditorViewModel and MoviesListViewModel; (2) DapperThumbnailRepository captive dependency (AddTransient captured by AddSingleton FfmpegThumbnailGeneratorService).

data-flows.md: Added four new M9 interaction flows — Section 14: Cover Image Side-Panel Load (OnSelectedMovieChanged fire-and-forget pattern with CTS cancel/replace); Section 15: Cover Image Edit Flow (CoverImageViewModel.LoadAsync → adjustments → ApplyNowCommand → atomic save); Section 16: Thumbnail Generation Flow (GenerateThumbnailsCommand batch path resolution → dialog → FfmpegThumbnailGeneratorService.GenerateAsync → per-frame FfmpegRunner + DapperThumbnailRepository + progress reporting); Section 17: Thumbnail Viewer Flow (ViewZoomedCommand → ThumbnailViewerViewModel → AvaloniaThumbnailViewerService window).
tech-stack.md: Already contains SixLabors.ImageSharp 3.1.12 in Image Processing section — no changes needed.
api-surface.md: All M9 types (ThumbnailGeneratorViewModel, FfmpegThumbnailGeneratorService, and all others) verified as documented in prior sessions — no changes needed.

comments.note: file-tree.md had two M9 files entirely absent from the annotated tree: ThumbnailGeneratorViewModel.cs (WP-017) in ViewModels and FfmpegThumbnailGeneratorService.cs (WP-020) in Infrastructure/Library. Both were present in api-surface.md but missing from file-tree.md, creating a navigation gap. Added both entries with full annotations.

MoviePropertiesViewModel.cs annotation in file-tree.md still described WP-028 as 'stored; not yet used' even after WP-032 fully implemented LoadMediaInfoAsync. Updated to accurately reflect the implemented state.

constraints.md had no M9-specific entries despite three notable architectural patterns introduced by the milestone: (1) the bidirectional selection sync guard in ThumbnailsView.axaml.cs, (2) the full-or-nothing image sub-VM initialisation contract, (3) the DapperThumbnailRepository captive dependency. All three are non-obvious patterns that would cause bugs if violated in future work. Documented all three.
